# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new APIs** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands paint, color filter, and image filter APIs. It also restores small-blur performance, speeds repeated SKSurface.Canvas access, refreshes HarfBuzz shaping, and fixes a macOS typeface race. This release removes deprecated .NET Interactive support and turns remaining pre-v4 obsoletes into compile errors.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are compile errors** — GRBackendRenderTarget constructors that take sampleCount and GRVkImageInfo or GRMtlTextureInfo now fail compilation; use the constructors without sampleCount. Replace the obsolete run-buffer span methods with Glyphs or Positions, and replace SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality with SKFontHinting and SKSamplingOptions. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive integration removed** — The deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension is no longer embedded in the SkiaSharp NuGet package. Remove dependencies on that extension and use another notebook rendering integration before upgrading. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — Moves the bundled renderer from Skia m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen and compatibility across the existing native platform builds. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146))

## API Surface

- **Fast paint bounds support quick-reject culling** — SKPaint.GetFastBounds reports a conservative device-space rectangle that includes path effects, strokes, mask filters, and image filters, and returns false when bounds cannot be computed reliably. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **Overdraw visualization completed** — SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps counts from SKOverdrawCanvas into a six-color heat map for rendering-performance diagnostics. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))
- **Image filter composition expanded** — SKImageFilter.CreateCrop constrains filter output with selectable tile behavior, while SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty supplies a transparent-black node that discards its input. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small raster blurs regain performance** — Routes small-sigma image blurs away from the slower raster-pipeline Gaussian pass across all native platforms. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))
- **Apple typeface stream access synchronized** — Fixes a data race when CoreText-backed typefaces open or reuse streams concurrently on Apple platforms. ([#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface.Canvas access accelerated** — Caches the surface-owned SKCanvas wrapper across calls and safely recreates the wrapper if a consumer explicitly disposes it. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz from 14.2.0 to 14.2.1 with AAT and Arabic shaping fixes, COLR v1 corrections, more reliable glyph extents, and subsetting fixes.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 29, 2026)

Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds, SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw, SKImageFilter.CreateCrop, and SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty. Restores small-sigma raster blur performance, caches SKSurface.Canvas wrappers, and fixes a macOS typeface stream data race.
